children: Emkay Global Financial' research report on Craftsman Automation

Craftsman (CAL) logged a robust 2Q, with consolidated revenue up 47% yoy (12% beat on our estimate). Consolidated EBITDA grew 30% yoy (4% below our estimates, due to margin pressure). Consolidated EBITDAM declined by ~250bps sequentially (~220bps lower than our estimates). CAL remains on a strong growth trajectory, with ~15% medium-term CAGR, with 2H revenue expected to exceed 1H levels, led by strong growth momentum in the aluminum products segment, supported by strategic investments over the past few years. The powertrain segment is also expected to sustain growth across segments, barring tractors, where growth may contract in 2H. Sunbeam is exiting the lowmargin business, primarily with the smaller customers, including some lossmaking accounts, to improve profitability. CAL remains on track to achieve $100mnpa stationary engine revenue target by FY30, with FY28/FY29 expected to reach ~30/50% of the target run-rate, supported by a strong order book. Commodity inflation along with rising manpower and energy cost remain a key headwind, with a marginal impact expected in 3Q and no incremental impact in 4Q. Aluminum price corrections are under negotiation with customers and are expected to materialize over the next 2 quarters.

We believe CAL is under a strong growth phase, supported by monetizing of past investments and a diversifying revenue base. We largely maintain FY28E/FY29E EPS and raise our TP by ~4% to Rs12,400 from Rs11,900 based on 16x Sep-28 EV/EBITDA.
